titanSays.line: 📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
🔭 Scouts come back pale. The sky looks wrong. Not cloudy, not dark — just... bigger. Like it's closer than it should be.
📻 The old ones point at the horizon and don't speak. The System, for once, is quiet too. Then: the Herald. It heralds the apocalypse the way dawn heralds the day.
📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Strike hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 7,3. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
Something pads into the clearing — The Herald. It's here.
You turn to leave — behind you, The Herald stirs.
The Herald stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.

🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Big Beast, The Herald, The Eater, Big Big, Loud-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Herald came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.

🚨 The Big Beast, The Herald, The Eater, Big Big, Loud-Eyes is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
Nobody met The Herald — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.
